rune of resilience.desc: Permanently increase your health by 1. Also used to evolve.

rune of strength.desc: Permanently increase your might by 1. Also used to evolve.

rune of knowledge.desc: Permanently increase your wits by 1. Also used to evolve.

rune of life.desc: Allows you to evolve. This rune is empowered with life, found in beasts and strong creatures.

rune of power.desc: Allows you to evolve into something powerful.

rune of purity.desc: Allows you to evolve backwards. This rune is etched on a spotless silver tablet.

rune of energy.desc: Allows you to evolve. This rune contains energy that can be used as electricity or something magical.

rune of water.desc: Allows you to evolve with some aquatic element.

rune of fire.desc: Allows you to evolve with some fiery element.

rune of gold.desc: Allows you to evolve. This rune is sought after by all humanoid creatures.

rune of stone.desc: Allows you to evolve. This rune is etched on a firm rock tablet.

rune of poison.desc: Allows you to evolve. This rune is seeping with venom.

rune of bones.desc: Allows you to evolve. This rune is etched on a bone.

rune of scales.desc: Allows you to evolve with protective layers.

rune of rot.desc: Allows you to evolve. This one smells particularly foul.

rune of shadows.desc: Allows you to evolve with a dark element.

rune of air.desc: Allows you to evolve. This rune is surrounded by thick mist.

demonic rune.desc: Allows you to evolve into demonic beings.
